name: Regemmelech
overview: Regemmelech is a male figure mentioned in the Bible as an emissary from Bethel who sought the favor of the LORD. His role is briefly noted without additional tribal or familial details. The Scripture highlights his mission rather than personal background.
namesAndTitles: The name Regemmelech means 'friend of the king.' This proper name, as recorded in Zechariah 7:2, does not appear to be given directly by God but carries a meaningful designation reflecting a relationship to royal authority or favor.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Regemmelech beyond his role as an emissary from Bethel. There are no additional relationships or kinship details provided.
scriptureSignificance: Regemmelech's significance lies in his representation of the people of Bethel seeking divine favor, as recorded in Zechariah 7:2. His role as an emissary underscores the community's desire for God's blessing and guidance during a critical period. Although briefly mentioned, Regemmelech serves as a symbol of earnest petition to the LORD within the prophetic narrative.
